name: Revenue
definition: Total net revenue across all channels

name: Comparable Store Sales
definition: YoY sales change in stores open >12mo

name: E-commerce Revenue
definition: Net e-commerce revenue

name: EBITDA Margin
definition: Adjusted EBITDA / Revenue

name: Gross Margin
definition: Gross profit / Revenue

name: Inventory Turn
definition: COGS / Avg Inventory

name: Inventory Forecast Accuracy (MAPE)
definition: Mean absolute % error at SKU-store-week
notes: Currently measured at SKU-store-week; caveats: doesn't account for new SKUs without history; bias toward under-forecast in promotions; instrumentation pre-dates current promotional dynamics

name: Stockout Rate
definition: % of SKU-store-day combinations with zero inventory

name: Sell-Through Rate (week 6)
definition: % of initial allocation sold in first 6 weeks

name: Markdown Rate
definition: Markdown $ / Initial $

name: Customer NPS (Post-Interaction)
definition: NPS score from post-interaction survey at 24h
notes: Measured 24h post-interaction; 22% response rate; biased toward extreme experiences (positive and negative); not comparable to NPS measured at other touchpoints

name: Customer Satisfaction Survey (CSAT)
definition: CSAT score (1-5) post-interaction

name: Loyalty Member Count
definition: Active members (purchase in last 12mo)

name: Loyalty Penetration
definition: % of revenue from loyalty members

name: Identity Match Rate
definition: % of customer records matched across source systems
notes: Critical for CDP program; gap from 87% target driven by deferred legacy CRM source + email-only records

name: Customer Acquisition Cost (Digital)
definition: Marketing $ / new customers acquired digitally

name: Customer Lifetime Value (3-year)
definition: Predicted 3-year value from cohort
notes: Model has not been refit since 2023; results are directionally useful but precision is low; fix on roadmap

name: Contact Center Containment
definition: % of contacts resolved without agent
notes: Driver of CC AI program; current containment is from IVR + chatbot; AI uplift target ~12 points

name: Average Handle Time (AHT)
definition: Average call duration end-to-end
notes: Up due to harder calls reaching agents (easy calls deflected)

name: First Call Resolution
definition: % of contacts resolved in first contact

name: Agent Utilization
definition: % of agent time on contacts

name: Loyalty Program Engagement Score
definition: Composite engagement metric
notes: Defined but not instrumented; on roadmap

name: Email Open Rate
definition: Std email metric

name: Email Click Rate
definition: Std email metric

name: Cart Abandonment Rate
definition: % of carts abandoned without purchase

name: Returns Rate (Apparel)
definition: % of apparel revenue returned

name: Store Conversion Rate
definition: % of visits resulting in transaction (counted)

name: Average Transaction Value
definition: Avg sale per transaction

name: Sales per Labor Hour
definition: Std

name: Application Availability (Critical Apps)
definition: % uptime for tier-1 systems

name: Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) — Security
definition: Avg time from incident to detection

name: Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) — Security
definition: Avg time from detection to resolution

name: Privileged Access Review Cadence
definition: % of privileged access reviewed in last 90 days

name: Vulnerability Patch SLA
definition: % of critical vulns patched within 14 days

name: DSR Response SLA
definition: % of DSRs responded to within 30 days

name: Cloud Cost — % of IT Spend
definition: Cloud / Total IT Spend

name: SaaS Spend per Employee
definition: SaaS spend / FTE

name: License Utilization (Top 25 SaaS)
definition: Active users / Licensed users
benchmark_source: Identified $1.24M annual waste; FinOps in progress

name: IT Spend as % of Revenue
definition: Std

name: IT Run / Change / Transform Mix
definition: % allocation

name: Vendor Concentration (Top 10)
definition: Spend with top 10 IT vendors / Total IT spend

name: AI Use Cases — Production Count
definition: Count of AI use cases in production
notes: Definition is contested; some teams count differently

name: AI Use Cases — Pilot Count
definition: Count of AI pilots in flight

name: AI Governance Council Decisions
definition: Count of decisions per quarter

name: Data Quality Score (Customer Domain)
definition: Composite data quality metric for customer data
notes: Defined but not instrumented; CDP program will require this

name: System of Record Coverage
definition: % of business processes with named system of record

name: Architecture Review Coverage
definition: % of programs in P2/P3 reviewed by ARB

name: Stage Gate Pass Rate
definition: % of programs passing gate on first attempt
notes: Stricter standards mean lower first-pass; trade-off accepted

name: Program On-Time Delivery
definition: % of programs hitting committed dates

name: Vendor SLA Adherence
definition: % of contracts meeting SLAs

name: Inventory Shrink Rate
definition: (Book inventory - physical inventory) / net sales; measures merchandise losses from theft, damage, and administrative error
confidence_in_measurement: Medium (physical counts 2x/year; interim estimates from cycle counts)
notes: Organized retail crime driving external shrink increase in 6 high-risk markets; internal shrink stable

name: Store Traffic (Weekly Visits)
definition: Total customer entrances measured by traffic counters across all 340 stores
formula: Sum of all entrance counter events per week
notes: Traffic-to-conversion improvement (store conversion rate +110bp YoY) partly offsetting traffic decline

name: Sales per Labor Hour (Store)
definition: Total store net sales / total paid labor hours in stores
formula: Net store sales / total paid store labor hours
notes: Improvement driven by labor model optimization; does not include training hours

name: Store Labor Cost % of Net Sales
definition: Total store labor cost (payroll + benefits) / store net sales
formula: Total store payroll + benefits / store net sales

name: New Hire Turnover Rate (Store 90-day)
definition: % of store associates who left within 90 days of hire / total new hires in the period
formula: Store associates departed ≤90 days / total new hires × 100
notes: High turnover in 3 urban markets driving disproportionate cost; manager tenure correlated with lower new-hire turnover

name: Inventory Days on Hand (DOH)
definition: (Average inventory / COGS) × days in period
notes: apex-forecast-2026 targets 10-day DOH reduction through improved planning

name: Inventory Aging — Units >180 Days on Hand
definition: % of active SKUs with >180 days of inventory relative to recent sales velocity
formula: Count of SKUs (DOH > 180 days) / total active SKUs × 100
notes: Aging inventory concentrated in apparel basics and seasonal carryover; clearance markdown rate rising as result

name: Markdown Rate by Quarter
definition: Markdowns taken as % of net sales (clearance + promotional)
notes: Higher markdowns driven by demand forecasting misses on new SKU introductions; apex-forecast-2026 directly addresses

name: Days Payable Outstanding (DPO)
definition: Average number of days to pay vendors
notes: Apex DPO shorter than peers; extending to 42 days would free ~$28M working capital

name: Vendor On-Time Delivery Rate
definition: % of purchase orders received within the agreed delivery window (±2 days)
formula: POs received within delivery window / total POs × 100
notes: Top 10 vendors at 91%; tail vendors driving underperformance

name: Gross Margin by Channel — Digital vs. In-Store
definition: Gross margin % on digital channel orders vs. in-store channel; measures channel profitability differential
formula: Channel net revenue - channel COGS / channel net revenue × 100
confidence_in_measurement: Medium (channel cost allocation has caveats — last-mile delivery costs partially shared)
notes: Digital margin includes last-mile shipping cost (partially absorbed); gross margin before shipping is 44.2%

name: Loyalty Redemption Rate
definition: % of loyalty points earned that are redeemed within 12 months
formula: Points redeemed within 12 months / points earned × 100
notes: High-tier members redeem 81%; low-tier 44%; low redemption indicates disengagement risk

name: Loyalty Member Dormancy Rate
definition: % of active loyalty members with no transaction in last 12 months
formula: Members with 0 transactions last 12 months / total active loyalty members × 100
confidence_in_measurement: Medium (CDP identity resolution incomplete at 71%; some dormant members may be duplicates)
notes: CDP activation expected to improve dormancy identification accuracy

name: Personalization Revenue Lift
definition: Incremental revenue from personalized email/web recommendations vs. control group (A/B measured)
formula: Revenue per session (personalized) / revenue per session (control) - 1 × 100
confidence_in_measurement: Medium (measured on 32 tests FY2025; test coverage not uniform across categories)
notes: PERS-2024 failure established that lift must be measured vs. baseline before scaling; this KPI documents the baseline measurement discipline

name: Email Unsubscribe Rate
definition: % of marketing emails sent resulting in unsubscribe
notes: Klaviyo compliance status — not on approved systems list for confidential customer data (PCI/GLBA boundary); data classification remediation in progress

name: Loyalty Tier Migration Rate (Upward)
definition: % of loyalty members who moved to a higher tier in the past 12 months
formula: Members with tier upgrade in last 12 months / total active loyalty members × 100
notes: Tier migration correlates with 3.4x higher LTV; improving migration rate is a key lever for CLV optimization

name: Working Capital Ratio
definition: Current assets / current liabilities; measures short-term liquidity
notes: Healthy; DPO extension opportunity would modestly compress ratio

name: Free Cash Flow (FCF)
definition: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures
notes: FCF improvement driven by demand forecasting; additional improvement expected from DPO extension

name: SG&A as % of Net Sales
definition: Total selling/general/administrative expense / net sales
notes: Technology investment in FY2026 will temporarily pressure SG&A; cost reduction expected post-program completion

name: Capital Expenditure as % of Revenue
definition: Total capex / net revenue
notes: Digital and AMS program capex driving increase; expected to normalize by FY2028

name: PCI DSS Compliance Score
definition: % of PCI DSS v4.0 requirements tested and passed in last annual QSA assessment
notes: 6 requirements remediation in flight; target pass before May 2026 assessment window

name: Data Privacy Request Fulfillment Rate (CCPA/CPRA)
definition: % of consumer data requests (deletion/access/opt-out) fulfilled within statutory 45-day window
formula: Requests fulfilled within 45 days / total requests received × 100
notes: 1.8% non-fulfillment due to CDP identity resolution gap — cannot locate all records for a consumer across systems; CDP Activation 2026 will resolve

name: Audit Finding Remediation Rate
definition: % of internal audit findings (all severities) remediated within agreed target dates
formula: Findings remediated on time / total findings × 100
trend: Down 5pp YoY (AMS program creating competing priorities)
notes: Critical findings (1–2 open) tracking to closure; medium/low findings impacted by resource constraints

name: Vendor Security Assessment Completion Rate
definition: % of critical/high-risk vendors with completed annual security assessment
formula: Vendors with completed assessment / total critical+high-risk vendors × 100
notes: 4 critical vendors with overdue assessments; Wipro (AMS consolidation primary vendor) flagged as overdue — tied to AMS-2023 lesson learned
